# Oak narration

Original synthetic performances directed for Lakshya Chopkar’s portfolio, November 2026. Generated offline with the built-in Ryan preset from Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice, model revision0c0e3051f131929182e2c023b9537f8b1c68adfe. No actor reference recording or voice cloning was used.

Source: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-TTS
Model: https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice
Model licence: Apache-2.0; see MODEL-LICENSE.txt. The speech model and authoring dependencies are not distributed with this website.

The 19 recordings follow the existing dialogue, making chapters and garden explanations. Performance direction requests a warm, lively and playful mentor, with smiling questions, varied emphasis and conversational pauses. Audio is mastered offline for consistent spoken-word level, encoded as mono MP3, and played without added echo, music or pitch shifting. Per-file integrity and measured audio values are recorded in manifest.json.

Browser playback loads only the selected thought. Microsoft Mark, where installed, is the preferred device fallback; other installed English voices remain usable.
